system_summary: A conditional, criticism-tested family of AOSE engineering configurations linking legitimate needs, chosen abstractions, roles and interactions, executable behaviour and observed effects, with bounded authority and selective revision. It is not a serial method or a guarantee of net benefit.

relations.GUARD: Affected actors or delegated needs determine the acceptance claim.
relations.PRECONDITIONS: The source and target criteria retain their own scope, implementation and environmental assumptions; selecting a branch does not discharge them.
relations.RELATIONAL_MECHANISM: Actor/dependency inquiry supplies the reason and legitimate scope for an acceptance condition; neither a diagram nor dependency arrow proves that condition is complete.
relations.FAILURE_WITNESS: A local source criterion can hold while the target is omitted, wrongly scoped or applied to a different subject/version; the claimed transfer then has no adequate warrant.
relations.EVIDENCE_FLOW: Transfer only the observations, constraints or warranted claims named by this relation; preserve their subject, configuration and uncertainty.
relations.AUTHORITY_FLOW: No authority is created by an evidential or descriptive link; the relevant actor must already be legitimately empowered.
relations.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAPER_PATH: When this dependency is absent, omit the edge; when a direct contract/test preserves it, no extra model or workflow is required.

alternative_configurations.NAME: Conventional software / no agent abstraction
alternative_configurations.TRIGGER: Centralised, object/service/actor/workflow control meets the actual needs more simply.
alternative_configurations.AUTHORITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Conventional permissions and accountable acceptance still apply.
alternative_configurations.EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS: Comparable requirements, adverse consequences and lifecycle costs; direct effect checks.
alternative_configurations.FAILURE_CONDITIONS: Conventional assumptions do not cover genuinely autonomous participants or open public obligations.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_RETIREMENT_PATH: Move to a richer branch only on demonstrated semantic need; remove unnecessary agency after substitution tests.
alternative_configurations.INPUT_CONFIGURATION_RELATION: A/B non-agent alternatives retained; not anti-AOSE.
alternative_configurations.COST_RULE: Every added modelling/runtime/assurance mechanism must earn its local lifecycle cost; required means required within this declared branch and trigger, not universally.

alternative_configurations.NAME: AO requirements analysis with conventional implementation
alternative_configurations.TRIGGER: Actor/dependency/goal models aid inquiry but runtime autonomy is not justified.
alternative_configurations.AUTHORITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Modelling delegation does not grant implementation authority.
alternative_configurations.FAILURE_CONDITIONS: The model is treated as proof of legitimacy or an agent runtime is added by habit.
alternative_configurations.SUBSTITUTION_RETIREMENT_PATH: Collapse the social view where a simpler adequate requirement representation suffices.
alternative_configurations.COST_RULE: Every added modelling/runtime/assurance mechanism must earn its local lifecycle cost; required means required within this declared branch and trigger, not universally.

alternative_configurations.NAME: BDI / deliberative-agent engineering
alternative_configurations.TRIGGER: Beliefs, goals, intentions and persistent/reactive choice provide an appropriate implementation abstraction.
alternative_configurations.AUTHORITY_ASSUMPTIONS: Agent choice is bounded by legitimate permissions; goal adoption is not authority.
alternative_configurations.EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENTS: Language/runtime semantics, failure/termination tests, environment mappings and relevant concurrency coverage.
alternative_configurations.FAILURE_CONDITIONS: The beliefs/goals/plans labels lack executable semantics or failures are equated with goal completion.

alternative_configurations.INPUT_CONFIGURATION_RELATION: A/B BDI branch retained with separately recovered lifecycle properties.
alternative_configurations.COST_RULE: Every added modelling/runtime/assurance mechanism must earn its local lifecycle cost; required means required within this declared branch and trigger, not universally.

conceptual_distinctions.intention: A proposed/persistent practical commitment, not a public obligation.
conceptual_distinctions.obligation: A role/public duty, not proof of authority or capability.
conceptual_distinctions.permission: A permitted action under current rules, not assurance of desired effect.
conceptual_distinctions.authority: Legitimate power to decide or alter the relevant state, not merely a score or prediction.
conceptual_distinctions.capability: Practical ability, not permission or willingness.
conceptual_distinctions.issued_action: A submitted command, not evidence of execution.
conceptual_distinctions.executed_action: The operation occurred, not proof of the intended external consequence.
conceptual_distinctions.observed_effect: Evidence of a consequence, not automatically legitimate acceptance.
conceptual_distinctions.accepted_outcome: The relevant legitimate acceptance condition is met under current support.

external_interfaces.condition: Needs, constraints and contested priorities enter through validation; no automatic authority follows.
Direct implementation and substitution are legitimate when requirements/evidence support them.
Percept/effect/version assumptions and access limits remain explicit.
All canonical properties, including negatives and uncertainty, are exported; no sibling conclusion is supplied.

revision_boundaries: A changed assumption reopens support/applicability; it does not logically negate the conclusion.
A method revision is assessed under its legitimate predecessor rule; it cannot authorise itself.
A role transition does not itself transfer/discharge incurred obligations.
Retiring a mechanism requires preserving the active obligations by a demonstrated substitute or legitimate discharge.

unresolved_composition_obligations.question: Do complete AOSE methodologies broadly outperform competent conventional engineering across comparable projects and lifecycle outcomes?

Does the newly synthesised conditional Evolved-AOSE configuration family produce greater net lifecycle benefit than the best applicable conventional alternatives under comparable requirements and resources?
What evidence suffices across partially observed obligations, opaque effects and time-sensitive changes? Case-specific assurance remains necessary.

relational_bundles.NAME: Same-decision cross-level conformance, authority and effect coupling
relational_bundles.BEARER: One consequential decision and the claim-specific relations among its legitimate requirement, authority, realisation and effects.
relational_bundles.DERIVATION: Combine the inherited criteria at the same subject, action, configuration, time and acceptance context. A separately true local record cannot close a different global claim.
relational_bundles.LOCAL_PASS_WITNESS: A permitted, correctly executed refund to B does not fulfil A's independently valid refund requirement. Local truth is possible, but the proposed global acceptance already fails the inherited compatible-support criterion.
relational_bundles.NOVELTY_TEST: The witness does not show a failure outside all applicable inherited global criteria. A-100 is not artificially restricted to technical claims to manufacture a new residual property.
relational_bundles.OBSERVABLE_CONSEQUENCE: Missing or incompatible joins block/defer/reopen the affected decision and reach the legitimate capable consumer.
relational_bundles.ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant identity, authority, configuration and effect information must be observable enough; otherwise retain uncertainty.
relational_bundles.COSTS_FAILURES: Correlation and consumer effort; stale keys, omitted effects and duplicate bureaucracy remain risks.
relational_bundles.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAPER_PATH: One direct contract/permission/result check may already establish the complete relation; no extra procedure is then needed.
relational_bundles.PROSPECTIVE_RETROSPECTIVE: An authorised bounded experiment may proceed on warranted predictions; acceptance of its outcome later requires relevant observations. Do not demand an as-yet-unproduced effect before all action.
relational_bundles.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Analytical relational instantiation of inherited criteria, not a new historical theorem or measured whole-method benefit.
